text: Teaching Objectives This program provides students with the necessary knowledge to become skilled acupuncture professionals who follow career paths in a variety of disciplines, including acupuncture, massage, therapy, education, science and research, and administrative duties in medical institutions. During the program, teachers will apply different teaching strategies, such as lecturing, group discussions, clinical demonstrations, modal presentation, skill training, clinical practice, social involvement, etc. there is a high focus on the basic practical training of Acupuncture and Massage. Main Courses Diagnostics of Chinese traditional Chinese Medicine, Chinese Herbology, Pharmacology of Traditional Chinese Medical Formulae, Science of Main and Collateral Channel Acupoints, Massage Maneuvers, Chinese Internal Medicine, Massage Therapy Duration 2 years Degree Warded Qualified student will be granted Master Degree byBeijing University of Chinese Medicine
